cells.gaps: The policy's period ended in 2025 and no row shows a successor sector policy announced, in drafting or validated; the 2022 World Bank project financed an evaluation of the policy and an update of its action plan, which is not a successor. Governance facts (the ministry coordinating and monitoring it in June 2021, the mandated ministry and donor finance of 2022-05-31) fall outside the 36 months to the as-at. The June 2021 retreat reviewed progress and gave no figures against the policy's targets, so reporting is activity; no delivery plan, results report or event in the last twelve months has been found.
cells.note: Politique nationale de développement des TIC (PNDTIC) 2010-2025: adopted by the Council of Ministers on 13 July 2011 and public, but its period ended in 2025, before the as-at, with no successor in preparation, so the cell is unplaced and lapsed. No national digital strategy has been found, so it is not under the national strategy; the development plan PND 2018-2027 and Vision 2040-2060 are logged in systems.csv as the noted class held instead.
